source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1111 implements focus() on in-app-notification and its container so the shortcut reaches the inner tabindex=0 div. The document activeElement is the outer host because the focused div is inside nested shadow roots. The accepted keyboard test checks that host after dispatching a composed KeyJ event; it does not inspect each inner activeElement or run a trusted key/screen-reader interaction. Keep the delegation and focus target together when changing the template.
title: Delegate notification focus through each shadow root to a tabbable container
